sections.text_helper: Section 19.4.10 "TIM14 auto-reload register (TIM14_ARR)" in chapter 19 (General-purpose timers (TIM14)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 541.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0xFFFF
Bits 15:0 ARR[15:0]: Auto-reload value
ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register.
Refer to Section19.3.1: Time-base unit on page520 for more details about ARR update and
behavior.
The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.
